title: USBC, Inc. 8-K Filing — Departure of Director and Separation Agreement
summary: USBC, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing the departure of Ronald P. Erickson as former Chairman, President, CEO, and Board member effective March 27, 2026, following the divestiture of the company's legacy non-invasive sensor technology business. The company entered into a Separation and General Release Agreement with Erickson on April 9, 2026, providing $375,000 in severance and accelerating vesting of his 167,500 unvested restricted shares.
key_points: Ronald P. Erickson departed USBC, Inc. effective March 27, 2026, concluding his service as Board member and President of the Science Division
The departure followed completion of the divestiture of the company's legacy non-invasive sensor technology business to Particle Acquisition Corporation
Separation Agreement dated April 9, 2026 provides Erickson severance equal to his annual base salary of $375,000, payable over one year
Erickson's 167,500 unvested restricted shares (50% of original 335,000 share award) accelerated and vested in full upon his last date of employment
The departure was not due to any disagreement with the company on operations, policies, or practices
Erickson will serve as principal officer of the Buyer (Particle Acquisition Corporation) solely for purposes of Section 6.07 of the Stock Purchase Agreement
